title: ToT Storefront capabilities.json
description: Requests optional surface changes. It may NOT weaken the compliance floor: for a regulated tenant, ageVerification and exciseTax cannot be disabled here (such a change is rejected). Safe uses are things like turning cart/checkout off for a marketing-only tenant.

cartCheckout.description: Enable/disable the managed cart + checkout. Disable only for marketing-only tenants.

ageVerification.description: REGULATED FLOOR: cannot be set false for a regulated tenant.

exciseTax.description: REGULATED FLOOR: cannot be set false for a regulated tenant.
